captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a rectangular interlocking fastener strip, similar to a plastic mushroom-head Velcro system. It features a thin, flat rectangular base plate with a regular array of small, vertical, mushroom-shaped pins protruding from its surface. Each pin consists of a slightly tapered cylindrical stem topped with a conical cap, designed to snap-fit into an opposing array of the same pattern.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, 3D-printable interlocking fastener strip in OpenSCAD. The design should consist of a thin rectangular base plate of customizable Width and Length, populated with a regular grid of mushroom-shaped pins controlled by a NotchSize parameter to adjust holding force.
captions.factory: The code defines a 'Fastener' module that creates a base plate using a 'cube' primitive with dimensions [Width, Length, PlatformHeight]. It then uses nested 'for' loops to iterate along the X and Y axes at a set 'NotchDistance'. At each grid point, a mushroom-shaped pin is constructed by translating and stacking two 'cylinder' primitives: a lower tapered cylinder for the stem, and an upper sharp conical cylinder for the cap.
